name: actual-egg-timer
description: Actual Egg Timer: a boiled-egg timer that computes the time from transient conduction and denaturation kinetics

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.core.json && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node tools/copyKeys.ts && node tools/swiftConstants.ts && npm run typecheck && node --test test/*.test.ts test/tools/*.test.ts
scripts.conformance: npm run fixtures:check && cd ios/EggTimerCore && swift test
scripts.ios:build: cd ios && xcodegen --quiet && xcodebuild -project ActualEggTimer.xcodeproj -scheme ActualEggTimer -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet build && xcodebuild -project ActualEggTimer.xcodeproj -scheme ActualEggTimer -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet build
